rationale: The TOTP envelope migration clears plaintext secrets after encrypting them, while tenant-resource ownership, durable token-issuance records, CIBA decision bindings, and shared run-token fences create authoritative state that older releases cannot enforce. The previous application therefore cannot safely resume on the migrated database. Recovery requires the controller-created, separately verified pre-update database backup; artifact-only rollback is intentionally blocked across this migration barrier.
